# Clean Club Company

> Clean Club Hospitality & Services (شركة كلاب كلين للتنظيفات والضيافة والخدمات) is Qatar's premier provider of professional live-in maids, monthly residential cleaning contracts, commercial janitorial solutions, and specialized event hospitality. Phone / WhatsApp: +974 3349 8554.

## Service Categories

- [Live-in Maid Contracts](https://cleanclub-cleaning.com/#live-in-offer): Full-time resident domestic staff under verified medical and legal compliance.
- [Hourly & Daily Cleaning](https://cleanclub-cleaning.com/#services): Flexible residential housekeeping visits on-demand.
- [Commercial & Corporate Janitorial](https://cleanclub-cleaning.com/#services): Structured cleaning contracts for corporate offices and institutions.
- [Deep Villa & Post-Construction](https://cleanclub-cleaning.com/#services): Intensive restoration and multi-surface deep sanitation.
- [Hospitality & Event Staffing](https://cleanclub-cleaning.com/#services): Professional waitstaff and cleaners for conferences and VIP events.
- [Steam Garment & Abaya Care](https://cleanclub-cleaning.com/#services): Professional fabric care using specialized vertical steam equipment.

## Technical Specifications & Architecture

- Technology Stack: HTML5 Semantic, Modern Vanilla CSS (Zero External Frameworks), Vanilla ES6+ JavaScript.
- Typography: Google Fonts (Cairo for Arabic RTL typography, Outfit for numerical and Latin elements).

- Hosting Platform: GitHub Pages / Cloudflare CDN Edge.
